text:
sophia: quick report from a customer PoC: using AsyncClient with retries we observed duplicate creates when the caller timeout triggers. caller sees TimeoutError but backend processed the request again later.

nate: version? minimal repro?

sophia: python-sdk 0.9.0-rc1. repro gist: async task calls client.create(..., timeout=0.7) and we log server requests. server shows two POSTs.

lee: likely two issues: (1) retry/backoff doesn't observe the coroutine cancellation or a passed deadline and keeps retrying; (2) idempotency key is generated lazily in the streaming branch so a replay can get a different key.

omar: immediate mitigation: instruct support to pre-generate Idempotency-Key and pass via headers. example snippet to share in KB: `headers={"Idempotency-Key": uuid4().hex}`.

ci-bot: CI: integration/async-retries queued. logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/streams/1101/logs

nate: proposal: add `deadline` (total-op timeout) distinct from `timeout` (socket/read). thread the deadline into RetryPolicy and Transport so retries stop when deadline passed. also ensure idempotency header is attached synchronously before any await.

sophia: agreed. also change typing: AsyncClient.send(deadline: Optional[float|timedelta]=None, timeout: Optional[float]=None). update stubs.

lee: for backwards compat keep `timeout` but document clearly. add an `allow_replay` opt-out param for sensitive endpoints (default True).

omar: i'll open a small PR to propagate a Deadline object; nate can add the early-bind fix and tests.

nate: test plan: fake server returns 502, delay, 200. assert single create when idempotency header prebound. add simulated caller cancel to ensure retry stops.

sophia: I'll write the KB snippet and a short note in the SDK README. tagging sdk/async, sdk/retries, devex.

lee: checklist: 1) propagate deadline to retry loop, 2) synchronous idempotency binding, 3) add tests/harness, 4) KB snippet + README example, 5) typing/stub updates.

sophia: thanks all — filing issue and adding to next sprint. :thumbsup:
